# shortcuts

Keyboard chords routed to views, focus and tiles.

Read first: `docs/features/shortcuts/spec.md`, `docs/features/shortcuts/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/shortcuts-cmd-n-follows-rail-order` — The number chords select the nth card in the order the rail currently displays, manual or attention, rather than staying attention-ranked. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: shortcuts, rail) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-cmd-n-follows-rail-order.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-jump-to-neediest-option-command-zero` — Option-Command-0 selects the neediest session by attention priority, ignoring the rail's sort mode and pinned block; no live session is a silent no-op. (accepted, 2026-09-04; features: shortcuts, rail) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-jump-to-neediest-option-command-zero.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-match-event-code-in-pure-module` — Chords match on the keyboard event's code, not its key, in one pure module holding the binding table; a hand-built unit test holds the Playwright gap. (accepted, 2026-09-04; features: shortcuts) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-match-event-code-in-pure-module.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-option-command-family-off-reserved-chords` — Session shortcuts move to the Option-Command family, measured clear in both browsers; the digits moved for consistency, not an observed failure. (accepted, 2026-09-04; features: shortcuts) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-option-command-family-off-reserved-chords.md`
